messages.text: Heads up: OFAC published an SDN list update this afternoon. SanctionsScreen should have ingested it on the 15:00 sync, but I'm going to verify the list version before we trust overnight screening.
I see the new version stamp in the SanctionsScreen admin view. Delta shows additions plus a couple of removals. Want me to pull the diff into a sheet?
Yes please. Flag any entries with Russia or Iran program tags first. Then we rescreen the active book against just the delta, not a full rerun.
For KYC: I have three onboarding cases mid-flight in KYCPipeline. Should I hold them until the delta rescreen finishes, or let them continue and catch any hits after?
Hold anything that hasn't cleared the screening step yet. Cases already past it get picked up by the delta rescreen. Should only be a couple of hours.
From the Risk side, do we know if any counterparties or lending exposures touch the newly listed names? Happy to run exposure through RiskEngine once you have a hit list.
Diff is up. 14 additions, 3 removals. Two additions carry entity tags that could fuzzy match business names in our commercial book. Sheet is linked in the pinned message.
Thanks. Let's run the delta against clients and counterparties now. Anthony, start with commercial. I'll look at the wealth side and cp_056 as well since it came up in last week's review.
Nadia, do we need to tell the business anything or notify the RMs? I don't want surprises if a payment gets held tomorrow morning.
Not yet, Linda. No confirmed matches. If anything survives first-level review I'll tell you and the RMs directly. Worst case is a short hold on outbound wires pending review.

Commercial results: one potential name match on {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0279}}, but it's a partial token overlap with a listed entity. Jurisdiction and registered details don't line up. Looks like a false positive, documenting the rationale now.
Agree after a quick look. Log it as a cleared false positive with the secondary identifiers you compared, and I'll sign off. Wealth side is clean, including {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0291}}.
Rescreen of the three pending onboarding cases is complete with no hits. Releasing the holds in KYCPipeline now.
Thanks all. Nothing on the counterparty side that needs a Risk escalation from my end. I'll hold off on the exposure run unless something changes.
Wrapping up: delta rescreen done, zero confirmed matches, one false positive cleared and documented. I'll post the audit summary in the compliance folder tomorrow morning.
